entities.name: 自主化 (autonomy)
entities.how_described: 本集说自主化是 Saronic 的产品方向——自主水面舰艇（autonomous surface vessels），并指出今天约一万亿美元的国防预算里只有 1% 投向自主化。

entities.name: AI 工具 (AI tooling)

evidence.quote: Today with AI tooling, you can write code a lot faster, but that also means your debug cycles are a lot faster.
